sentences.text:
Singamsetty Chandra Sekhar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh,
on 4 September, 2020

Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3626 of 2020
Order:

This is an application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C), by the petitioner/A9, seeking quashment of F.I.R. No.4 of 2020 of Krishnapatnam Port Police Station,
SPSR Nellore District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 272, 273,188 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 20(b)(ii) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 and 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text: 2. It is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned counsel for petitioner so also the learned Additional Public Prosecutor that the issue in the present Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the earlier order of this Court, dated 27.08.2018, in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018.

3. Having regard to the said order and for reasons recorded therein, this Criminal petition is also allowed in terms thereof, quashing the proceedings in F.I.R.No.4 of 2020 of Krishnapatnam Port Police station, SPSR Nellore District, except to the extent of the offence punishable under Section 20(b)(ii) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985.
